launch_user: An individual developer using a supported AI CLI with a configurable provider base URL

states.available: Implemented, customer-deliverable, and runtime-proven on a supported path
states.beta: Implemented but not yet proven or reliable enough for an availability promise
states.planned: Not customer-deliverable and must not be marketed as available

protection_scope.protected_input: Recognized detector matches in supported, uncompressed UTF-8 request bodies routed through Promtect
protection_scope.upstream_behavior: Promtect masks supported matches before forwarding the remaining prompt to the configured upstream
protection_scope.restoration: Transparent mode restores an unchanged sentinel in the streamed response; strict mode never restores plaintext
excluded: Encoded values such as base64 unless their decoded form is present as supported text
Multipart fields that are not valid UTF-8 text
Traffic from tools that do not route through Promtect
Secrets whose format or context is not covered by an active detector

approved: Masks recognized known-format secrets in supported request bodies before the configured upstream receives them
Runs as a local loopback proxy without installing a root certificate
Core contains no Promtect telemetry or hosted control-plane dependency
Audit records are designed to contain detector names and counts, not detected values
The per-request vault explicitly zeroizes the secret values it owns on drop
prohibited: catches every API key, token, and password
the model never sees any secret
